[[File:Ring of dueling detail.png|left|140px]]
The '''ring of dueling''' is a teleportation ring that may be made by casting [[Lvl-2 Enchant]] on an [[emerald ring]], granting 37 [[Magic]] experience. A full ring of dueling will provide 8 teleports before it crumbles away into nothing. 

When teleporting using the ring, the message {{Mes|You rub the ring...}} will be displayed, followed by a message with the number of charges remaining, ex. {{Mes|Your ring of dueling has four uses left.|colour=Purple}} If using the last charge on the ring, the message {{Mes|Your ring of dueling crumbles to dust.|colour=Purple}} will be displayed instead. 

Due to the low cost of the ring, many players use it to bank quickly at the [[Castle Wars]] chest. Furthermore, the [[Ferox Enclave]] teleport allows a player to use the [[Pool of Refreshment]] whilst gaining full health, prayer and run energy, although the Ferox Enclave teleport places the player slightly farther away from a bank chest.

Each charge costs {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Ring of dueling(8)|0.125}}}} [[coins]] if all 8 charges are used, {{NoCoins|({{GEP|Ring of dueling(8)}}+{{GEP|Nature rune}}-765)/7}} if using High Level Alchemy (as described below), or {{NoCoins|({{GEP|Ring of dueling(8)}}+{{GEP|Nature rune}}-510)/7}} if using [[Low Level Alchemy]]. Alternatively, [[Explorer's ring]] can be used 30 times per day for a cost of {{NoCoins|({{GEP|Ring of dueling(8)}}-510)/7}}. This is viable if fewer than 210 charges are used on average each day, though it gives no Magic experience.
